# NesT

**Category:** ViT · **Code:**
[`timm/models/nest.py`](https://github.com/huggingface/pytorch-image-models/blob/main/timm/models/nest.py) ·
**Architectures:** 6 · **Pretrained weights:** 3 (3 with ImageNet-1k results)

Nested Transformers (NesT) apply self-attention locally within non-overlapping image blocks and aggregate neighbouring
blocks between stages. Weights converted from the official JAX release.

## Papers

* [Nested Hierarchical Transformer: Towards Accurate, Data-Efficient and Interpretable Visual
  Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2105.12723)

## Usage

See the [Quickstart](../quickstart) for loading pretrained weights, image preprocessing and fine-tuning, and [Feature
Extraction](../feature_extraction) for using the models as backbones.

```py
>>> import timm
>>> model = timm.create_model('nest_tiny_jx.goog_in1k', pretrained=True)
>>> data_config = timm.data.resolve_model_data_config(model)
```

## Model API support

| Feature | `Nest` |
|---|---|
| [`features_only=True` feature maps](../model_api#intermediate-features) | ✓ (strides 4, 8, 16) |
| [`forward_intermediates()`](../model_api#intermediate-features) | ✓ |

| [Any input size, no changes needed](../model_api#input-size) | ✗ |
| [`set_input_size()`](../model_api#input-size) | ✗ |
| [`dynamic_img_size=True`](../model_api#input-size) | ✗ |
| [`set_grad_checkpointing()`](../model_api#training-hooks) | ✓ |
| [Layer-wise LR decay (`group_matcher()`)](../model_api#training-hooks) | ✓ |
| [`reset_classifier()`](../model_api#classifier) | ✓ |

✓ supported, ✓ (square) works for square sizes only, ✗ not supported, – not needed (the model already accepts any input
size). Checked by running each feature on a randomly initialized model (`Nest` with `nest_tiny` at 224), other
architectures of the same class are expected to behave the same. See the [Model API](../model_api) page for details.
